zh.title: 預約培訓
zh.lead: 告訴我們你的學校或機構名稱，我們會有專人聯絡跟進，與你商議培訓日期和安排。

form.placeholderMessage: 例如：希望的培訓日期、參加教師人數。

form.fail: 暫時未能提交。請直接電郵至

en.title: Book a Training
en.lead: Tell us about your school and we’ll get in touch to discuss your training date and on-site arrangements.

form.placeholderMessage: For example: preferred dates and the number of teachers.
form.ok: Thank you! We’ve received your details and will contact you shortly by email or WhatsApp.
form.fail: We couldn’t send this just now. Please email us directly at
